Wo.bar_b_note: A's braced timber frame, plank cap and stone footing read as built, but a lone thin panel with flat cream infill on bright flat grass under a clear sky sits well below Palworld base pieces and has none of Valheim's light or atmosphere; B's blank glowing slab sinks it outright.

Ix.bar_b_note: Warm plank floor, chandeliers and B's benches and hearth glow make it a real interior, but the big empty floor, flat even lighting with no shafts or haze, and dark stone pillars filling the frame edges keep it short of Palworld/Valheim finish.

Zh.bar_b_note: A's large, fully wrapped recipe and ingredient text on a translucent blue-grey panel is close to a shipping crafting UI, but it shows only three recipes, has tiny keyboard glyphs and no teal interaction accent, and B's clipped micro-text and faint 'Craft: A / Enter' hint read as debug UI.

Sd.bar_b_note: The village approach with lit windows and a glowing hall door carries real charm by day and night, but inside, a sparse nave, no visible rain mood and (in B) big diagonal timber posts filling the near field keep it short of the reference finish.

Ka.bar_b_note: B's blue runner, warm shrine glow and hearth at the reverse end give the room a direction, but blown-out cream walls, a wide empty cobble floor with evenly scattered pedestals and stands, and no light shafts or depth haze keep it from Palworld/Valheim finish.

Aa.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder with a clear face, readable eyes and a grounded green-and-brown outfit that fits the Meadows palette, but the soft toy-like shading and a bare dark stage give no evidence of Valheim-class light, so it reads as a character showcase, not a shipping in-world frame.

Ur.bar_b_note: A clean, saturated water-drake silhouette with a white belly and spotted back reads instantly, but glossy toy-like materials below the owner's naturalistic fur/scale bar, plus broken faint poses (A crumpled into itself, B floating in faint mid), keep it below Palworld-class creature finish.

top_changes.change: Crossing Hall (Ix, Sd, Ka): put a large warm focal at the shrine end (hearth or brazier-lit shrine with a gold glow), furnish the empty nave floor with tables, rugs and clutter in clusters, add a warm key light with soft shafts and haze, and pull the near-field stone pillars and timber posts out of the fixed cameras.
Craft panel (Zh): keep A's large wrapped type, widen the list so 5-6 recipes fit, and replace the tiny key icons with large controller-first teal button glyphs for Craft and Leave at full contrast.
Homestead wall (Wo): build a thick timber-frame wall piece with textured wattle/plaster infill, a plank cap and a separate stone footing that joins its neighbours, instead of a single card panel.
